verified_facts.statement: I10-P0-R1 started from protected hwm-control/main 8d0c62c5b5c147a3cfd6d0ef202850292cda2bd4, hwm-lab/main e37ea628d9c793d5e87bc8b903a9b85b4371991c, hwm-context/main d651f40d0bb3a3ef0e52fca95e5400ed3db3d772, and hwm_predictor/main 8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4.

The protected I10-P0 supply-chain contract, ADR 0007, graph-health schema, focused P0 tests, I10-0072 Knowledge Delta, and Issue #72 surfaces define timeout fail-closed semantics but contain no exact numeric Graphify builder execution timeout; protected code search also contained no builder_wall_clock_timeout_seconds field before this remediation.

The historical hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v1 predecessor remains immutable at exact Git blob a22feb23061d96e920f4a8974bdbb94de9e8988e; ADR 0007 and all graph snapshot/metadata/health/query schemas also remain immutable, and the protected core BUILD_STATUS schema map remains closed.

Owner-approved remediation decision is one authoritative monotonic full-builder wall-clock timeout of exactly 900 seconds, starting only at verified-wheelhouse-ready, network-denied, read-only-exact-source-ready and ending only at canonical-artifact-emission-complete.

The 900-second timeout covers offline installation, exact structural Graphify invocation, output parsing, normalization, schema validation, digest calculation, and canonical artifact emission; timeout terminates the process tree, rejects partial snapshot/metadata, deletes partial canonical artifacts, sets timeout_incomplete_build with usable=false and null snapshot identity, forbids publication, selects deterministic raw-source fallback, and permits only a new clean disposable retry with the same exact inputs and no partial-output reuse.

decisions.decision: Create hwm-graphify-supply-chain/v2 as a forward-only amendment and keep v1 byte-for-byte immutable.
decisions.rationale: The exact timeout was omitted from the accepted P0 contract, so retroactively changing v1 would erase historical provenance.

decisions.decision: Use exactly 900 seconds on a monotonic wall clock for the complete builder execution boundary and require a new versioned amendment for any future change.
decisions.rationale: The implementation agent must not choose or silently relax a correctness- and availability-affecting timeout.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing graph schemas and closed BUILD_STATUS core schema map unchanged.
decisions.rationale: This remediation changes only the supply-chain execution policy, not graph serialization or bootstrap core schema registration.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Edit graphify-supply-chain.v1.json or ADR 0007 in place.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The accepted v1/ADR 0007 state is historical contract evidence and must remain immutable.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Let Issue #73 choose a timeout or increase it after a timeout failure.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would move a normative architecture decision into implementation and permit silent policy drift.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Bypass exact-head CI or use a generic source writer after the claim gate failure.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Exact-head CI and the installed controlled publisher are mandatory trust boundaries.
